content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue. I am using Windows XP on my programming device. When I attempt to open an example project in [product_name], the project does not appear on the home page.
Please upload your [product_name] project as a ZIP file to the forum.
The project was obtained from the [company_name] website. [url] After downloading to the controller, I can see the Swimming Pool application in the web server.

I have not encountered any issues with this myself. However, I use Windows 7 Professional SP1, 64-bit. It's possible that the [product_name] is not compatible with Windows XP. You might consider submitting a support request.

Hello [user_name], [product_name] is supported for: ● [product_name]: [product_name] [article_no]. ● Java Runtime Environment 1.8.0_121 is the recommended version; ● Web browsers that support HTML5, such as Microsoft Internet Explorer 10.0+, Mozilla Firefox 11.0+, Google Chrome 16.0+, and Apple Safari 5.0+; ● Operating systems: Windows (32 & 64 bit, including Windows 7 and Windows 10), Mac OS (including 10.9, 10.10, 10.11), and Linux Suse (11.3 sp3, kernel 3.0.76).

analysis.insight_summary: The issue arises because the user cannot open an example project using [product_name] on Windows XP. Others report the software works properly on newer Windows versions, and documentation indicates Windows XP is not supported for [product_name], which is likely the source of the problem.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to open and view example projects in [product_name] on Windows XP as is possible on more recent operating systems.
